name: fix_imports
description: Analyze and fix import-related issues in a file: undefined symbols, circular imports, unused imports, relative imports. Uses the code-index symbols/refs tables for symbol lookup and import graph. WARNING: auto_fix=true writes directly to file without transaction protection. For safer editing, use fix_imports without auto_fix to get suggestions, then apply them via edit_transaction. For circular imports, recommends structural changes (extract shared types).

workspace_dir.description: REQUIRED: Absolute path to the project root directory. Call reindex first.

max_candidates.description: Max candidate symbols per undefined symbol (default: 10)
